tools.name: Merge PDF
tools.desc: Combine several PDFs into one file, in the order you choose.

tools.name: Split PDF
tools.desc: Break a PDF into single pages, page ranges or equal chunks.

tools.name: Remove pages
tools.desc: Click the pages you don't need and save a clean copy.

tools.name: Extract pages
tools.desc: Pick pages and save them as a new PDF or separate files.

tools.name: Organize PDF
tools.desc: Reorder, rotate and delete pages by dragging thumbnails.

tools.name: Compress PDF
tools.desc: Shrink scanned and image-heavy PDFs for email and upload.

tools.name: Repair PDF
tools.desc: Fix damaged PDFs that won't open or show errors.

tools.name: OCR PDF
tools.desc: Make scanned PDFs searchable so you can find and copy their text.

tools.name: JPG to PDF
tools.desc: Turn photos and scans (JPG, PNG, WebP) into one PDF.

tools.name: Word to PDF
tools.desc: Convert DOC and DOCX files to PDF with the layout kept intact.

tools.name: PowerPoint to PDF
tools.desc: Turn PPT and PPTX slideshows into PDF, one slide per page.

tools.name: Excel to PDF
tools.desc: Convert XLS and XLSX spreadsheets into easy-to-share PDFs.

tools.name: HTML to PDF
tools.desc: Turn HTML code or a saved web page (.html) into a PDF.

tools.name: PDF to JPG
tools.desc: Save each page as a high-quality JPG or PNG image.

tools.name: PDF to Word
tools.desc: Turn a PDF into an editable Word file, keeping text, tables and images.

tools.name: PDF to PowerPoint
tools.desc: Turn PDF pages into PowerPoint slides you can present or edit.

tools.name: PDF to Excel
tools.desc: Pull tables out of a PDF into an Excel sheet with real rows and columns.

tools.name: PDF to PDF/A
tools.desc: Convert to PDF/A, the archive format required by courts and government portals.

tools.name: PDF to Text
tools.desc: Pull out all the text from a PDF to copy or save.

tools.name: Rotate PDF
tools.desc: Turn every page, or only the pages that came out sideways.

tools.name: Add page numbers
tools.desc: Stamp page numbers in the corner or center of each page.

tools.name: Add watermark
tools.desc: Place a text stamp such as DRAFT or CONFIDENTIAL.

tools.name: Crop PDF
tools.desc: Trim white margins from every page by a set amount.

tools.name: Unlock PDF
tools.desc: Remove the password and restrictions from a PDF you can open.

tools.name: Protect PDF
tools.desc: Add a password so only people who know it can open the file.

tools.name: Sign PDF
tools.desc: Draw your signature and place it anywhere on a page.
